longTitle.officialTitle: To authorize the Secretary of the Interior to correct a land ownership error within the boundary of Rocky Mountain National Park, and for other purposes.

main.enactingFormula: Be it enacted by the Senate and House of Representatives of the United States of America in Congress assembled,

section.heading: SHORT TITLE.
section.content: This Act may be cited as the “Rocky Mountain National Park Ownership Correction Act”.

paragraph.heading: Federal land.—
paragraph.content: The term “Federal land” means the approximately 0.18 acres of land depicted as “TR04-168-1” on the map.

paragraph.heading: Map.—
paragraph.content: The term “map” means the map entitled “Rocky Mountain National Park Proposed Forsyth Family Land Exchange”, numbered 121/154,326, and dated June 2019.

paragraph.heading: Non-federal land.—
paragraph.content: The term “non-Federal land” means the approximately 0.18 acres of land depicted as “TR04-169” on the map.

paragraph.heading: Secretary.—
paragraph.content: The term “Secretary” means the Secretary of the Interior.

section.heading: ROCKY MOUNTAIN NATIONAL PARK LAND EXCHANGE.

subsection.heading: Authorization of Exchange.—
subsection.content: To correct a longstanding land ownership error, if the owner of the non-Federal land offers to convey to the Secretary all right, title, and interest of the owner in and to the non-Federal land, the Secretary shall convey to the owner of the non-Federal land, subject to valid existing rights, all right, title, and interest of the United States in and to the Federal land.

subsection.heading: Valuation.—
subsection.content: The value of the Federal land and the non-Federal land to be exchanged under this Act shall be considered to be of equal value.

subsection.heading: Administration.—
subsection.content: The non-Federal land acquired by the Secretary under this section shall be administered by the Secretary as part of Rocky Mountain National Park.

subsection.heading: Availability of Map.—
subsection.content: The map shall be on file and available for inspection in the appropriate offices of the National Park Service.
